    Class
    Description
    ConfigurationManager
    Manages application configuration parsing and validation.
    ConfigurationManager.IntSetting
    Integer settings: property key, default value, and valid range [min, max].
    DatabaseRepository
    Repository for database operations with support for MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQLite, DuckDB, MongoDB and OpenSearch.
    DatabaseRepository.SqlRow
    Parameter values of one gav row: the JDBC setter calls are recorded on a conversion thread, and replayed on the writer's PreparedStatement with the same setter and value types.
    DatabaseType
    Supported target database types.
    MvnScanner
    Scan all artifacts in maven repository.
    MvnScanner.Batch
    One converted batch, ready to write: documents for MongoDB, prepared rows for SQLite and DuckDB, encoded bytes (the payload) for the others: COPY data for PostgreSQL, MySQL and MariaDB, a bulk body for OpenSearch.
    MvnScanner.RawRecord
    One raw index record with its sequence number.
    OpenSearchClient
    Minimal OpenSearch REST client for the bulk load, on the JDK HttpClient: no client library needed.
    RunSummary
    Machine readable summary of one execution, written as log/<timestamp>-<dbtype>.json next to the text log of the same run.
